headline: 22.5 tonnes of cucumbers from Afghanistan not allowed into Kyrgyzstan
summary: Kyrgyzstan refused entry to 22.5 tonnes of cucumbers imported from Afghanistan due to non-compliance with phytosanitary requirements and missing labelling.
why: Phytosanitary rules govern cross-border agricultural trade, and rejected shipments affect importers and regional produce flows.
original_headline: В Кыргызстан не пропустили 22,5 тонны огурцов из Афганистана
